title: FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning
title_zh: FlowAct-R2: 超越聊天Avatar的 Streaming Multimodal 参考和主动代理规划

paragraphs.en: We present FlowAct-R2, a framework for interactive humanoid video generation that combines continuous multimodal control with proactive agent planning. Our method consists of two coupled components. First, a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video backbone to accept rolling action prompts, streaming audio, and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references. Video-driven rotary positional embeddings align reference chunks with the generation timeline, while reference-plus-image conditioning and partially noised historical motion frames preserve appearance and avoid accumulated drift. Second, a Proactive Interaction Agent separates pre-online planning from online scheduling and response: it prepares a persona, a long-horizon agenda, and reusable multimodal skills in advance, then autonomously schedules behaviors, responds to audience input, and handles interruptions during a live session. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time 720p generation and hour-scale streaming across entertainment streaming, live shopping, video chatting, and live vlogging.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 FlowAct-R2，一个用于交互式人形视频生成的框架，它将连续的多模态控制与主动智能体规划相结合。 我们的方法由两个相互耦合的组件构成。 首先，一个流式多模态参考扩散变换器将预训练的 Seedance 2.0 Mini 参考转视频主干模型进行适配，使其能够接受滚动动作提示、流式音频以及动态更新的照片、音频和视频参考。 视频驱动的旋转位置嵌入将参考片段与生成时间线对齐，而参考加照片的条件约束以及部分添加噪声的历史运动帧则能保留外观并避免累积漂移。 其次，一个主动交互智能体将预在线规划与在线调度和响应分离开来：它提前准备好角色设定、长期议程和可重复使用的多模态技能，然后在直播过程中自主安排行为、回应观众输入并处理中断。 FlowAct-R2 支持实时 720p 视频生成，并可在娱乐流媒体、直播购物、视频聊天和直播日志等场景中实现小时级的流式传输。

paragraphs.en: Digital humans are emerging as practical tools for interactive applications, yet most existing systems remain confined to a single scenario, such as dialogue [ 5 , 21 , 4 , 16 ] , talent performance [ 20 , 18 ] , or live commerce and product demonstration [ 9 , 12 ] . To support open-ended live interaction, however, a digital human should go beyond a collection of task-specific generators and behave more like a real human streamer: it should maintain a coherent persona and long-term context, proactively organize what to do next [ 15 , 6 , 17 , 13 ] , respond to unexpected user input without abandoning the ongoing activity [ 11 , 3 ] , and coordinate speech, body motion, object interaction, and scene-level actions.
paragraphs.zh: 数字人正逐渐成为互动应用中的实用工具，但大多数现有系统仍局限于单一场景，例如对话 [ 5 , 21 , 4 , 16 ] 、才艺表演 [ 20 , 18 ] ，或直播电商与产品演示 [ 9 , 12 ] 。 然而，为了支持开放式的实时互动，数字人不应仅仅是一组特定任务生成器的集合，而应更像一位真实的人类主播：它需要保持连贯的人物设定和长期上下文，主动规划下一步行动 [ 15 , 6 , 17 , 13 ] ，在应对用户意外输入时不中断当前活动 [ 11 , 3 ] ，并协调语音、身体动作、物体互动以及场景层面的行为。

paragraphs.en: This requires both a generator capable of continuously realizing changing multimodal behaviors and an agent responsible for planning, scheduling, interrupting, and resuming them throughout a long-running session. Recent systems have advanced continuous humanoid video generation, real-time audiovisual interaction, and interactive world simulation [ 14 , 2 , 8 ] , but two coupled challenges remain. The generator needs to incorporate dynamically changing image, audio, and video references while preserving identity and temporal continuity. Meanwhile, the agent needs to prepare complex activities in advance and make latency-sensitive decisions online, allowing unexpected user inputs to redirect ongoing behavior without disrupting the session.
paragraphs.zh: 这既需要一个能够持续实现动态多模态行为的生成器，也需要一个负责在整个长时间运行会话中规划、调度、中断和恢复这些行为的智能体。 近期的系统在连续类人视频生成、实时视听交互和交互式世界模拟方面取得了进展 [ 14 , 2 , 8 ] ，但仍然存在两个相互关联的挑战。 生成器需要整合动态变化的图像、音频和视频参考，同时保持身份一致性和时间连续性。 与此同时，智能体需要预先准备复杂活动，并在线做出对延迟敏感的决定，从而允许用户意外输入重新引导正在进行的行为，而不会中断整个会话。

paragraphs.en: To address these coupled challenges, we present FlowAct-R2, which pairs a streaming multimodal reference generator with a proactive interaction agent (Figure 1 ). This design provides three main capabilities:
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些相互关联的挑战，我们提出了 FlowAct-R2，它将流式多模态参考生成器与主动交互智能体相结合（图 1）。 这种设计提供了三项主要能力：

sents.en: To address these coupled challenges, we present FlowAct-R2, which pairs a streaming multimodal reference generator with a proactive interaction agent (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 为了解决这些相互关联的挑战，我们提出了 FlowAct-R2，它将流式多模态参考生成器与主动交互智能体相结合（图 1）。

sents.en: This design provides three main capabilities:
sents.zh: 这种设计提供了三项主要能力：

paragraphs.en: Streaming Multimodal Reference Generation. By extending diffusion forcing from chunkwise generation to streaming multimodal references, FlowAct-R2 enables real-time video generation with rolling prompts and multimodal references, including continuously updated images, audio, and video, and supports hour - level ultra - long video generation with 720p.
paragraphs.zh: 流式多模态参考生成。 通过将扩散强制从分块生成扩展到流式多模态参考，FlowAct-R2 实现了实时视频生成，支持滚动提示词和多模态参考（包括持续更新的图像、音频和视频），并支持长达数小时的 720p 超长时间视频生成。

sents.en: Streaming Multimodal Reference Generation.
sents.zh: 流式多模态参考生成。

sents.en: By extending diffusion forcing from chunkwise generation to streaming multimodal references, FlowAct-R2 enables real-time video generation with rolling prompts and multimodal references, including continuously updated images, audio, and video, and supports hour - level ultra - long video generation with 720p.
sents.zh: 通过将扩散强制从分块生成扩展到流式多模态参考，FlowAct-R2 实现了实时视频生成，支持滚动提示词和多模态参考（包括持续更新的图像、音频和视频），并支持长达数小时的 720p 超长时间视频生成。

paragraphs.en: Proactive Interaction Agent. To enable digital humans to autonomously drive their behavior when no external input is present, while seamlessly responding when interactions arise, FlowAct-R2 introduce an agent workflow with pre-online planning and online scheduling and response, which supports persona-driven behaviors, interruption handling, and skill execution for autonomous live interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 主动交互智能体。 为了让数字人在没有外部输入时能够自主驱动其行为，同时在交互发生时能无缝响应，FlowAct-R2 引入了一种包含上线前规划、在线调度与响应的智能体工作流程，该流程支持以角色为导向的行为、中断处理以及技能执行，以实现自主的实时交互。

sents.en: Proactive Interaction Agent.
sents.zh: 主动交互智能体。

sents.en: To enable digital humans to autonomously drive their behavior when no external input is present, while seamlessly responding when interactions arise, FlowAct-R2 introduce an agent workflow with pre-online planning and online scheduling and response, which supports persona-driven behaviors, interruption handling, and skill execution for autonomous live interactions.
sents.zh: 为了让数字人在没有外部输入时能够自主驱动其行为，同时在交互发生时能无缝响应，FlowAct-R2 引入了一种包含上线前规划、在线调度与响应的智能体工作流程，该流程支持以角色为导向的行为、中断处理以及技能执行，以实现自主的实时交互。

paragraphs.en: Rich Behaviors Across Diverse Live Scenarios. FlowAct-R2 supports real-time text and audio interactions across four representative scenarios—video chatting, live shopping, entertainment streaming, and interactive gaming—generating not only conversational responses but also expressive behaviors and task-oriented actions beyond conventional question answering.
paragraphs.zh: 在多样化实时场景中的丰富行为。 FlowAct-R2 支持在四种典型场景（视频聊天、直播购物、娱乐流媒体和互动游戏）中实现实时的文本与音频交互，不仅能生成对话式回应，还能产生富有表现力的行为以及超越传统问答的任务导向型动作。

sents.en: Rich Behaviors Across Diverse Live Scenarios.
sents.zh: 在多样化实时场景中的丰富行为。

sents.en: FlowAct-R2 supports real-time text and audio interactions across four representative scenarios—video chatting, live shopping, entertainment streaming, and interactive gaming—generating not only conversational responses but also expressive behaviors and task-oriented actions beyond conventional question answering.

paragraphs.en: FlowAct-R2 has two coupled components: a Streaming Multimodal Reference Diffusion Transformer (DiT) that produces video, and a Proactive Interaction Agent that determines the behavior and its schedule. DiTs provide the underlying Transformer-based diffusion architecture [ 7 ] . As shown in Figure 2 , offline preparation provides the persona, agenda, and skill assets. Online scheduling combines these resources with audience events and interaction history, then supplies changing conditions to the generator.
paragraphs.zh: FlowAct-R2 包含两个耦合的组件：一个生成视频的流式多模态参考扩散 Transformer（DiT），以及一个决定行为及其时间表的主动交互智能体。 DiT 提供了基于 Transformer 的基础扩散架构 [ 7 ] 。 如图 2 所示，离线准备阶段提供角色设定、议程和技能资产。 在线调度将这些资源与观众事件和交互历史相结合，然后将变化的条件提供给生成器。

sents.zh: FlowAct-R2 包含两个耦合的组件：一个生成视频的流式多模态参考扩散 Transformer（DiT），以及一个决定行为及其时间表的主动交互智能体。

sents.en: DiTs provide the underlying Transformer-based diffusion architecture [ 7 ] .
sents.zh: DiT 提供了基于 Transformer 的基础扩散架构 [ 7 ] 。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 2 , offline preparation provides the persona, agenda, and skill assets.
sents.zh: 如图 2 所示，离线准备阶段提供角色设定、议程和技能资产。

sents.en: Online scheduling combines these resources with audience events and interaction history, then supplies changing conditions to the generator.
sents.zh: 在线调度将这些资源与观众事件和交互历史相结合，然后将变化的条件提供给生成器。

paragraphs.en: The generator adapts the pretrained Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video (R2V) backbone, retaining its reference preservation capability. Diffusion Forcing assigns independent noise levels to sequence tokens [ 1 ] . FlowAct-R2 uses this formulation for autoregressive streaming inference while preserving the backbone’s bidirectional spatiotemporal modeling. Conditioning also becomes a stream: action prompts, driving audio, and image, audio, or video references can be updated or switched as the session proceeds. This supports changes such as presenting a new product or invoking a reference-guided performance within an ongoing stream.
paragraphs.zh: 该生成器对预训练的 Seedance 2.0 Mini 参考到视频（R2V）主干网络进行了适配，同时保留了其参考保留能力。 扩散强迫机制为序列中的各个词元分配独立的噪声水平 [ 1 ] 。 FlowAct-R2 采用这种公式进行自回归流式推理，同时保留了主干网络的双向时空建模能力。 条件输入也变为一种流：动作提示、驱动音频以及图像、音频或视频参考可以在会话过程中更新或切换。 这支持在持续进行的流式处理中执行变更，例如展示新产品或调用由参考引导的表演。

sents.en: This supports changes such as presenting a new product or invoking a reference-guided performance within an ongoing stream.
sents.zh: 这支持在持续进行的流式处理中执行变更，例如展示新产品或调用由参考引导的表演。

paragraphs.en: Rotary position embedding (RoPE) encodes positional relationships through rotations [ 10 ] . FlowAct-R2 uses a video-driven variant to align incoming reference chunks with the corresponding generation timeline. This provides temporal alignment when references arrive or change during generation. Explicitly trained reference-plus-image conditioning, denoted ( R + I ) ​ 2 ​ V (R+I)2V , anchors identity and appearance. The model additionally conditions on partially noised historical motion frames to improve robustness to imperfect generated histories and reduce error accumulation. Specialized audio-driven training supports synchronization of speech, lip movements, expressions, and head poses, while coarse-to-fine inference progressively restores visual details.
paragraphs.zh: 旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）通过旋转来编码位置关系 [ 10 ]。 FlowAct-R2 使用一种由视频驱动の変体，将传入的参考片段与对应的生成时间线对齐。 这为参考片段在生成过程中到达或变更时提供了时间对齐。 经过显式训练的“参考加图像”条件输入，表示为 ( R + I ) ​ 2 ​ V (R+I)2V，用于锚定身份和外观。 该模型还以部分添加噪声的历史运动帧作为条件输入，以提高对不完美生成历史的鲁棒性并减少误差累积。 专门的音频驱动训练支持语音、唇部动作、表情和头部姿态的同步，而由粗到精的推理过程则逐步恢复视觉细节。

paragraphs.en: Proactive agent planning follows a two-stage design that moves long-horizon preparation outside the latency-sensitive interaction loop while retaining online responsiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 主动智能体规划采用两阶段设计，将长期准备过程移出对延迟敏感的交互循环，同时保持在线响应能力。

paragraphs.en: The agent derives a persona from multimodal character assets, including text, images, audio, video, and manually prepared material. It organizes the session into a long-horizon agenda and compiles complex behaviors into reusable multimodal skills. The persona specifies how the character should behave, the agenda supplies activities to pursue, and the skills provide prepared resources for execution. This moves session organization and complex behavior preparation out of the immediate interaction loop.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体从多模态角色资产（包括文本、图像、音频、视频以及人工准备的材料）中推导出角色设定。 它将会话组织为长期议程，并将复杂行为整合为可复用的多模态技能。 角色设定规定了角色的行为方式，议程提供了需要执行的活动，而技能则提供了用于执行的预设资源。 这样，会话组织和复杂行为的准备工作就被移出了即时交互循环。

sents.en: The agent derives a persona from multimodal character assets, including text, images, audio, video, and manually prepared material.
sents.zh: 智能体从多模态角色资产（包括文本、图像、音频、视频以及人工准备的材料）中推导出角色设定。

sents.en: It organizes the session into a long-horizon agenda and compiles complex behaviors into reusable multimodal skills.
sents.zh: 它将会话组织为长期议程，并将复杂行为整合为可复用的多模态技能。

sents.en: The persona specifies how the character should behave, the agenda supplies activities to pursue, and the skills provide prepared resources for execution.
sents.zh: 角色设定规定了角色的行为方式，议程提供了需要执行的活动，而技能则提供了用于执行的预设资源。

sents.en: This moves session organization and complex behavior preparation out of the immediate interaction loop.
sents.zh: 这样，会话组织和复杂行为的准备工作就被移出了即时交互循环。

paragraphs.en: During a session, the agent combines the prepared agenda and skills with audience text or audio events and summarized interaction history. It makes a behavior decision about what to perform and a scheduling decision about when and how to perform it. Depending on the context, a behavior can be initiated, overlaid, deferred, interrupted, or resumed. This permits the avatar to continue agenda-driven activity without continuous prompting and to respond when an audience event arrives.
paragraphs.zh: 在一次会话中，智能体将准备好的议程和技能与观众的文字或音频事件以及总结后的交互历史相结合。 它会做出关于执行什么行为的决策，以及关于何时和如何执行该行为的调度决策。 根据上下文，一个行为可以被启动、叠加、推迟、中断或恢复。 这使得虚拟形象能够在没有持续提示的情况下继续以议程为导向的活动，并在观众事件出现时作出回应。

paragraphs.en: The schedule is expressed through idle, listening, speaking, and skill-execution periods. These periods supply rolling prompts, audio, and multimodal reference updates to the DiT. Interaction history is updated as the session evolves, giving subsequent decisions access to prior context. The agent and generator therefore operate at complementary levels: the agent manages session behavior and timing, while the generator realizes those decisions as a continuous video stream.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程通过空闲、监听、说话和技能执行阶段来呈现。 这些阶段为 DiT 提供滚动提示、音频和多模态参考更新。 随着会话的推进，交互历史会不断更新，使后续决策能够访问先前的上下文信息。 因此，智能体和生成器在互补的层面上运行：智能体管理会话行为和时机，而生成器则将这些决策实现为连续的视频流。

paragraphs.en: FlowAct-R2 generates real-time 720p video. We demonstrate changing references and audience interaction in four settings. Entertainment streams combine audience conversation with singing, dancing, and other skills. Shopping streams show product presentation, item try-on, and transitions between product references. Video chats demonstrate listening and expressive turn-taking. Live vlogs combine scene changes with audience-driven branching. These examples illustrate how the same agent–generator interface supports both conversational and task-oriented behavior. Figures 3 and 4 show selected frames from the demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: FlowAct-R2 可生成实时 720p 视频。 我们在四种场景下展示了参考对象的变化和与观众的互动。 娱乐直播将观众对话与唱歌、跳舞及其他技能相结合。 购物直播展示产品演示、商品试穿以及不同产品之间的切换。 视频聊天展现了倾听与富有表现力的轮流发言。 实时视频日志将场景切换与由观众引导的分支内容相结合。 这些例子说明，相同的智能体-生成器接口如何支持对话型和任务导向型行为。 图 3 和图 4 展示了演示中的部分精选帧。

sents.en: Figures 3 and 4 show selected frames from the demonstrations.
sents.zh: 图 3 和图 4 展示了演示中的部分精选帧。

paragraphs.en: Vidu S1 supports real-time interactive video generation through spoken interaction [ 19 ] . In the human evaluation, FlowAct-R2 achieves GSB scores of +54.76% for video quality and +40.48% for real-time interaction against Vidu-S1. The accompanying comparison describes improvements in visual clarity, motion naturalness and expressiveness, action responsiveness, and the contextual appropriateness of dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: Vidu S1 支持通过语音交互进行实时互动视频生成 [ 19 ]。 在人类评估中，FlowAct-R2 的视频质量 GSB 分数比 Vidu-S1 高出 +54.76%，实时交互分数则高出 +40.48%。 随附的对比说明展示了视觉清晰度、动作自然度与表现力、动作响应性以及对话情境适宜性的改进。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 compares the two systems across both listening and response phases. While the audience is speaking, FlowAct-R2 produces continuous listening-state behavior through changes in gaze, head pose, and facial expression, whereas Vidu-S1 remains close to the same frontal pose, smile, and hand gesture. During the subsequent response, FlowAct-R2 continues with varied facial delivery. The comparison highlights the richer nonverbal behavior planned by FlowAct-R2 across conversational turns.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 对比了这两个系统在倾听和回应两个阶段的表现。 在听众说话时，FlowAct-R2 通过眼神、头部姿态和面部表情的变化，持续表现出倾听状态的行为；而 Vidu-S1 则基本保持相同的正面姿态、微笑和手势。 在接下来的回应阶段，FlowAct-R2 继续以多样化的面部表情进行表达。 这一对比凸显了 FlowAct-R2 在对话回合中规划出的更丰富的非语言行为。

sents.en: Figure 5 compares the two systems across both listening and response phases.
sents.zh: 图 5 对比了这两个系统在倾听和回应两个阶段的表现。

paragraphs.en: Vidu-S2 supports streaming reference conditioning, allowing product images to be introduced or switched during an ongoing interactive video session [ 18 ] . Figure 6 compares outputs for the same product references. Across three successive products, FlowAct-R2 retains the red packaging layout, the green pouch’s subtle line pattern, and the shallow octagonal box. Vidu-S2 does not complete these reference switches cleanly: attributes from adjacent products remain and blend into the newly generated object, producing predominantly white packaging, a prominent branch graphic, and a tall polygonal tin. In the separate cylinder example, it replaces the pale patterned wrap with multicolored stripes. These cases reveal both object fusion during switching and reduced fidelity in packaging details and proportions. We also demonstrate text-triggered dancing in both systems and reference-video-driven dancing in FlowAct-R2.
paragraphs.zh: Vidu-S2 支持流式参考条件输入，允许在持续的交互式视频会话中引入或切换产品图像 [ 18 ]。 图 6 对比了使用相同产品参考时生成的输出结果。 在三个连续的产品中，FlowAct-R2 保留了红色包装布局、绿色袋子的细微线条图案以及浅色的八角形盒子。 Vidu-S2 未能干净地完成这些参考切换：相邻产品的属性仍然存在并融合到新生成的物体中，导致包装以白色为主，并出现了显眼的树枝图形和一个高大的多边形铁盒。 在独立的圆柱体示例中，它将浅色的图案包裹替换为多色条纹。 这些案例揭示了切换过程中发生的物体融合，以及包装细节和比例保真度的下降。 我们还展示了两种系统中通过文本触发的舞蹈效果，以及在 FlowAct-R2 中由参考视频驱动的舞蹈效果。

sents.zh: 我们还展示了两种系统中通过文本触发的舞蹈效果，以及在 FlowAct-R2 中由参考视频驱动的舞蹈效果。

paragraphs.en: FlowAct-R2 advances live digital humans along three dimensions. First, streaming multimodal reference generation accepts rolling prompts and dynamically updated image, audio, and video references for continuous real-time video synthesis. Second, the proactive interaction agent separates offline preparation of personas, agendas, and skills from online behavior scheduling, enabling autonomous activity while responding to user input and interruptions. Third, the unified system supports both expressive and task-oriented behaviors across video chatting, live shopping, entertainment streaming, and live vlogging. Together, these capabilities move digital humans beyond reactive talking avatars toward persistent visual agents that can plan and act through continuous video.
paragraphs.zh: FlowAct-R2 在三个维度上推动了实时数字人的发展。 首先，流式多模态参考生成能够接受滚动输入的提示词，并动态更新图像、音频和视频参考，以实现持续的实时视频合成。 其次，主动交互智能体将角色设定、议程和技能等的离线准备与在线行为调度分离开来，使其能够在响应用户输入和中断的同时自主执行活动。 第三，这一统一系统支持在视频聊天、直播购物、娱乐流媒体和实时视频日志等场景中实现表达性行为和任务导向行为的结合。 这些能力共同推动数字人从被动的对话虚拟形象，转变为能够通过持续视频进行规划与行动的持久视觉智能体。
